newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court upholds legal challenge to CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court upholds legal challenge to CVRD sale.

text.p: A Brazilian high court upheld an injunction that prevents the government from privatizing Companhia Vale do Rio Doce, a court spokesman said.
The president of the Superior Justice Tribunal (STJ) threw out a government appeal which sought to overturn the injunction, which was granted Friday by a Federal Court in Sao Paulo.

An STJ spokesman said any government appeal against the Sao Paulo injunction had to be heard by a full session of the Regional Federal Tribunal in Sao Paulo. He added that the STJ was not the place to launch an appeal.
The vice president of the Sao Paulo Regional Federal Tribunal on Monday rejected an initial appeal to the injunction.

A separate case lodged by the government with the STJ, which was due to be judged on Wednesday, seeks to nominate a single court in Brasilia as soley responsible for hearing all challenges to the auction.
